content.title: Implement: write user-friendly markdown documentation
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/user-docs-spec.md

Read the spec AND the review comments on issues mpdptgq69t and mpdpthrliu before starting.

Your task (AC2 + AC3 from the spec):

Part 1 - Remove old docs:
Delete the generated TypeDoc output directories and the existing hand-written markdown files in the docs directory. See spec for the full list of files to delete.

Part 2 - Write 8 new markdown files in docs/markdown/:
1. overview.md - introduction, key features, quick example
2. getting-started.md - install, init, first session (CLI + JS)
3. authentication.md - auth modes, tokens, user management
4. issue-object.md - properties, computed fields, status lifecycle, event sourcing
5. hierarchy-and-blockages.md - parent-child, status constraints, auto-promotion, blockages, cycle detection
6. storing-issues-in-git.md - .agentrack/ structure, orphan branch, push/pull
7. cli-reference.md - all agt commands with syntax, flags, examples
8. javascript-reference.md - Tracker class methods, exported types, examples

Writing guidelines:
- Audience: developers and AI agent operators, NOT library contributors
- Tone: clear, concise, practical
- Always show both CLI and JavaScript examples where applicable
- Cross-reference between doc files using relative links
- Standard markdown, no Docusaurus-specific syntax
- Each file should be over 100 lines with non-trivial content
- The CLI reference must document ALL commands listed in the spec
- The JS reference must document ONLY public exports, NOT internal modules

The spec contains detailed content outlines for each section.

content.content: Context for content writing: The library exports a Tracker class with methods: init, create, update, list, view, history, next, addComment, updateComment, deleteComment, listComments, addBlockage, resolveBlockage, deleteBlockage, listBlockages, registerUser, listUsers, revokeUser, regenerateToken, push, pull. Exported types include IssueProperties, ComputedIssue, IssueStatus, CreateIssueOptions, UpdateIssueOptions, ListFilters, NextResult, AgentrackError, and various event and blockage and user types. CLI command is agt. Status flow: idea then todo then in-progress then done then closed. Auth modes: open, read-only, strict. Issues stored on orphan git branch _agentrack via worktree. The existing docs in the docs directory (introduction.md, hierarchy.md, commands.md, issue-blockages.md, user-auth.md) contain accurate reference content that can be restructured into the new format - read them for factual accuracy before deleting.
